image_description: A young boy with dark curly hair is blowing a large soap bubble using a wand. The main bubble is large, spherical, and translucent, showing iridescent rainbow colors on its surface and reflecting the background. A smaller bubble floats to the right. The boy is wearing a dark shirt with yellow accents. The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field.
